title: TSMC open to partnership with Elon Musk's Terafab as chip giant's Q3 profit hits record $23.6 billion
source_used: Livemint; Focus Taiwan (CNA); CNBC headline only
key_facts: TSMC Q3 net profit NT$763.06 billion (about $23.6 billion), up 68.7%; revenue NT$1.49 trillion, up 50.9% (Livemint).
Customers named by Livemint: Nvidia, Apple, AMD and Broadcom.
C.C. Wei, TSMC chairman and chief executive: demand for advanced chips remains 'extremely robust'; TSMC is working to expand capacity.
TSMC raised its 2026 sales growth forecast to 44% in US dollars, kept 2026 capex at $60-64 billion; Q4 revenue guided at $52.3-$54.3 billion (Focus Taiwan; Livemint citing Reuters).
2nm chips were 8% of Q3 sales; demand for CoWoS packaging stays strong and TSMC will work with customers to ensure enough capacity (Focus Taiwan).
TSMC is cautious going into 2027 because of rising component prices and macro uncertainty.
CNBC headlines (15 Oct): TSMC capacity is a 'fierce' battleground for AI customers; Nvidia, Apple, Broadcom in a 'fierce' battle for manufacturing space. Detail not read.
quote_evidence: "We have no intention to leave food on the table for others, and we want to capture every piece of business possible." (Wei, Livemint)
Wei said demand for advanced chips remained "extremely robust". (Livemint)
why_it_matters_hint: Tight capacity at TSMC shapes who gets AI and phone chips first.
notes: CNBC page blocked; the earnings call read at Livemint and Focus Taiwan. The contest among Nvidia, Apple and Broadcom is CNBC's headline claim only.
